messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick flag — ACME usage dropped ~40% last week and their renewal is in 30 days. I want a compact triage + feedback capture flow we can share with them that focuses on caching / batching / streaming tweaks and the enablement session agenda. Anyone able to sketch a customer-facing checklist?
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can draft. high-level: 1) verify hotspot endpoints 2) suggest conservative cache TTLs 3) batch window tuning 4) streaming fallbacks + UX tips 5) capture qualitative feedback post-call.
Leo (Platform SRE): note infra constraints: if we increase batching we need to confirm Dedicated pool headroom or configure fallback to hosted. Also warm KV cache for top prefixes before the call.
Sam (Solutions Eng): here's a tiny config example we can show the customer for a conservative approach:
```json
{"cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_seconds": 300}, "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 8, "window_ms": 20}, "streaming": {"enabled": true, "fallback_mode": "chunked"}}
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): Suggest we recommend incremental changes (one knob at a time) + telemetry hooks. capture these metrics: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cache_hit_rate, error_rate.
Maya (CSM): Good. For the feedback capture, let's use a short survey + a 15m post-enable checkin. Example quick survey questions: "Did response speed improve?", "Any changed hallucination patterns?", "Which flows still time out?" Keep it <5 Qs.
Irene (AE): I can book a 30m enablement call next Tue with ACME. Would prefer us to send the checklist 24h before. I can include execs.
Leo (Platform SRE): Operational checklist for us: - prefill KV cache for top 20 prefixes (script below) - validate autoscale headroom in Dedicated pool - set temporary read-only routing to reduce write amplification
Leo (Platform SRE): ```bash
# prefill example (pseudo)
./prefill_kv.sh --tenant acme --keys top20 --warmup=60
```
OpsBot: Internal playbook added: https://redwood.internal/cs/playbooks/renewal-triage-compact (permissions: cs, solutions, sres). Deployment history: last edit 2026-02-10 by Sam.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Also recommend we instrument a short A/B: current vs cached/batched config with a simple routing flag so we can show delta to the buyer. Use a small % of traffic for the test.
Maya (CSM): Action list: @Sam draft the 1-pager checklist + sample config (due EOD tomorrow). @Leo produce prefill script and verify Dedicated headroom (due EOD today). @Irene schedule call and request 24h pre-read. I'll own the post-call survey + summary.
Maya (CSM): One-pager should be customer-facing (non-technical summary) + an appendix with sample config and telemetry keys. Keep language brief and prescriptive.
Irene (AE): Ack — will confirm time and attendees after booking.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll ping when the draft is up, will include a small troubleshooting flow: e.g., if p95 increases after batching -> reduce window_ms or revert.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. If anything blocks, drop it here. Otherwise we'll use OpsBot link in the pre-read. :thumbsup:
